daily.today_energy: The Moon in Gemini is stirring up your mind while your ruling planet the Moon clashes with Mars in Leo. You're feeling chatty but restless—lean into curiosity instead of frustration. Good day to process feelings through conversation.
daily.love: Venus in Libra is bringing harmony to your relational vibes. If you're coupled, this is solid ground for real talk. Single? Your charm is naturally elevated. Just don't overthink—your gut knows what it wants.
daily.career: Mercury in Scorpio keeps your focus sharp and strategic. The Mars-Jupiter conjunction is pumping up ambition everywhere, so channel that into your projects. This is a day to propose ideas or start something you've been sitting on.
daily.health: That Moon-Mars square might have you feeling a bit wired. Physical activity helps—run, dance, or stretch it out. Stay hydrated and don't skip meals; your nervous system needs grounding today.

weekly.overview: This week pulls you between comfort and growth, Cancer. The Moon's journey from grounded Taurus through chatty Gemini into bold Leo mirrors your own internal shift. Mars conjuncts Jupiter early week—pure amplification energy—while the Sun's square to Mars midweek tests your patience. Best Day: Wednesday. Watch-Out Day: Thursday when things feel chaotic. By weekend, Venus sextiles Jupiter, softening tensions.
weekly.love: Early week feels cozy and intimate as the Taurus Moon invites deeper connection. Midweek, Mars-Jupiter conjunction cranks up your confidence and magnetism—you're magnetic without trying. Thursday's Sun-Mars square might create friction if you're feeling defensive; take space if needed. By weekend, Venus sextiles Jupiter and suddenly everyone wants your attention. Lead with authenticity, not performance.
weekly.career: This is your power week, though it won't feel linear. Mars conjuncting Jupiter Tuesday-Wednesday supercharges ambition; pitch ideas, ask for what you want. Sun-Mars square Thursday through Friday brings obstacles—don't force momentum. Use this pause to refine strategy. Mars shifts into Virgo by weekend, bringing detail-oriented energy perfect for execution. Perfect timing to turn ambitions into actual plans.
weekly.health: The Taurus Moon early week grounds you nicely—slow mornings, nourishing food, gentle movement. Midweek Mars-Jupiter can make you overcommit; check your energy before saying yes. That Sun-Mars square might spike stress or irritation; yoga or walking helps. By weekend, focus on recovery and sustainable habits. Your body's asking for consistency over intensity right now.
